_meta.description: Base power effects for Mutants & Masterminds 4e. All 'description' fields are original, short paraphrases written for this project, not taken from the rulebook. Mechanical fields (effectType, action, range, duration, check, resistance, baseCost, statIntegration, config) reflect game rules/facts, not copyrighted prose. Companion to docs/mm-powers-architecture.md (read first) and modifiers.json.
_meta.configNote: config is the effect's list of configurable qualities (the per-effect choices docs/mm-powers-architecture.md §9 defers). Each entry is { key, label, type ('select'|'multiselect'|'text'|'checkbox'|'allocation'|'repeatable'|'points'), overrides?, multiselectWith?, options? }. The player's choice is stored under 'key' in the power effect instance's config: a single value for select/text, a list of values for multiselect. 'overrides' names a base game-term field (e.g. 'resistance') the chosen value replaces in the generated summary; without it the choice is appended. 'multiselectWith' names an extra modifier whose presence upgrades a select field to multiselect (e.g. Affliction's degrees become multiselect only once the 'extra_condition' extra is attached). For select/multiselect fields, options are { value, label } pairs (condition options use the condition id as value). A 'repeatable' field's rows are shaped by its 'columns', each { key, label, type } with type 'text', 'int' or 'trait'; a 'trait' column is a trait picker whose 'source' names which list it offers (see traitSourceKey); its stored value is a trait key, optionally QUALIFIED with '::' to narrow it to one row - 'Expertise::Law' is a skill focus, 'Stealth::spec::Urban' a specialized pool, 'Improved Critical::Sword' an advantage bought for a subject. Those are the character sheet's own row ids, so a granted row lands exactly where the bought one would. A field carrying both a 'trait' column and an 'int' column is a TRAIT ALLOCATION: each row names a trait and the ranks put into it, and those ranks are spent out of the effect's own rank. Enhanced Trait is the one base effect built that way.
_meta.baseCostModeNote: baseCostMode names HOW an effect's base cost is charged; core.rules.powers_cost holds one registered handler per mode and a mod's python_module can register another. Omitting the key means 'flat'.

baseCostModeKey.flat: baseCostValue points per rank - the ordinary rule, and the default when the key is absent
baseCostModeKey.as_trait: The effect costs whatever the traits it raises cost to buy outright, summed unrounded across its trait allocation and rounded once. baseCostValue is then only the NOMINAL rate the per-rank extras and flaws are read against: a -1/rank flaw takes 2 to 1 and so halves the whole total. The final cost is floored at 1 point.

_meta.rankFollowsAllocationNote: rankFollowsAllocation says the effect's rank IS the ranks its trait allocation spends, not a budget the player sets. Only meaningful on an effect with a trait allocation, and only Enhanced Trait sets it: that effect's cost comes from the traits it raises, so its rank has no independent meaning and a hand-set one is just a second number to keep in step. The constructor shows such a rank read-only and writes it from the rows; over-allocation cannot happen, so it is not checked. Omitting the key leaves the rank a hand-set budget, which is what Enhanced Senses, Enhanced Movement, Comprehend, Immunity and Feature want.

traitSourceKey.traits: The traits a power can buy up or down: abilities, non-derived resistances, skills
traitSourceKey.boost_traits: As 'traits', plus advantages - what an Enhanced Trait may raise or a Reduced Trait lower
traitSourceKey.all_traits: As 'traits', plus the derived stats that can be rolled but not bought (Defence, Initiative) - for a field asking what is CHECKED rather than what is changed

_meta.implicitModifiersNote: implicitModifiers lists modifier ids the effect carries as part of its own definition rather than as a player's choice. core.rules folds them into the effect's BASE game terms, untinted, before any attached modifier — so they read as part of the record, cost nothing (they never sit on the instance) and render no chip. Only their 'overrides' and 'grantsAttack' apply; stepping/checkBonus/checkNote are for attached modifiers. Today's sole use: an attacking effect implicitly has the 'attack' extra, which is what supplies its 'Attack vs. Defense' check — which is why these effects declare 'check': null of their own.
_meta.effectTypeNote: effectType is the CATALOG TAXONOMY: it groups the constructor's effect palette and seeds the Type game-term row. It is not what makes an effect an attack — the 'attack' modifier is (see implicitModifiersNote), and that modifier overrides the effective Type row. So an offensive Control effect files under Control in the palette while its card reads Type 'Attack'.

effectTypeKey.Attack: Offensive; carries the 'attack' modifier implicitly; always resistible
effectTypeKey.Movement: Grants or improves a movement mode
effectTypeKey.Alteration: Transforms the user's body or form

statIntegrationPatternKey.passive_permanent: Always contributes its bonus while the power exists and isn't suppressed (see docs/mm-powers-architecture.md §6-7)
statIntegrationPatternKey.passive_toggle: Contributes its bonus only while actively maintained/toggled on
statIntegrationPatternKey.instant_action: Not a standing bonus — invoked on demand as an action, resolves immediately
statIntegrationPatternKey.resource_pool: Grants an allocatable sub-budget rather than a direct stat bonus

affectsKey.ability: One of the six core abilities
affectsKey.advantage: A specific advantage, granted at the ranks named rather than added to a printed total
affectsKey.resistance: Grants/boosts resistance to a specific effect or descriptor rather than a general trait
affectsKey.recovery: Recovery check bonus, not an ongoing stat
affectsKey.none: No standing character-sheet stat; used as an action
affectsKey.special: Custom/narrative effect not mapped to a standard stat

_meta.applyNote: statIntegration.apply names WHICH RULE reads a stat effect once its effect is active; core.rules.appliers holds one registered applier per kind and a mod's python_module can register another. Alongside it, amountPerRank (default 1) and amountFlat (default 0) say what the record is worth at a given rank: flat + rank * perRank. All three default to M&M's own rule -- a bonus worth exactly the effect's rank -- so an effect that states none of them behaves as it always has. A record only carries a stat effect at all when it is configurableTarget or names a statIntegration.target.

applyKey.bonus: Add the amount to the trait the record targets (Enhanced Trait, Protection) - or, for an advantage, grant it at that many ranks. A target the sheet does not track contributes nothing.
applyKey.penalty_removed: Cancel that much of a penalty standing on the target, rather than granting a bonus
applyKey.penalty_replaced: Leave a smaller penalty in place of the one standing on the target; the amount is what remains
applyKey.speed: Grant ranks of the named movement mode
applyKey.sense: Grant ranks of the named sense quality

effects.name: Affliction

config.label: Overcome by
config.hint: Defaults to the resisting defense; may differ (e.g. resisted by Dodge, overcome by Will).

config.label: Transformed into
config.hint: The Personal Range effect the Transformed condition imposes - Morphing them, Shrinking them, Teleporting them elsewhere. Only effects that take a standard action or less are offered, since the rules allow no others.

config.label: At rank
config.hint: The rank the imposed effect runs at. Its cost must not exceed this Affliction's own total cost.

effects.description: Inflicts an escalating condition on a target instead of damage.

resistanceOutcomes.note: Affliction's rungs are the conditions the player picked when building the power, so each degree reads its own config field rather than a fixed list.

effects.name: Burrowing
effects.description: Grants the ability to tunnel through earth or similar material.

effects.name: Communication

config.label: Medium
config.hint: The sense the messages travel through (a required choice).

effects.description: Lets you send and receive messages over distance through a chosen medium.

effects.name: Comprehend

config.label: Comprehend
config.hint: Spend the effect's ranks across categories; each is independently tiered (Languages scales furthest).

effects.description: Lets you understand or be understood by languages, animals, or alien minds.

effects.name: Concealment

config.label: Concealed from
config.hint: Spend the effect's ranks on the senses you are hidden from: one rank buys one sense, two ranks the whole sense type. Sight costs double (2 for normal sight, 4 for every sight sense). Touch senses are missing on purpose — hiding from touch means being incorporeal, which is the Insubstantial effect.

allocOptions.label: Sight
allocOptions.description: Normal sight first, then every sight sense — infravision, ultravision and the rest included. Sight is the double-cost type.

allocOptions.label: Hearing
allocOptions.description: Normal hearing first, then every hearing sense, so sonar and ultra-hearing find nothing either.

allocOptions.label: Smell
allocOptions.description: Normal scent first, then every olfactory sense.

allocOptions.label: Taste
allocOptions.description: Normal taste first, then every taste sense.

allocOptions.label: Radio
allocOptions.description: Normal radio sense first, then every radio sense.

allocOptions.label: Mental
allocOptions.description: Normal mental sense first, then every mental sense.

allocOptions.label: Special
allocOptions.description: One sense that fits no other type, then every sense of that type.

effects.description: Hides you from a chosen sense type, from a shadow-blend to full invisibility.

effects.name: Create
effects.description: Conjures solid objects or terrain out of nothing.

effects.name: Damage

config.label: Strength-Based
config.hint: Adds your Strength rank to the Damage rank (and its cost).

effects.description: A direct harmful attack — the basis for most offensive powers.

success.note: unless the target's Toughness is Hardened, Impervious or Impenetrable against this attack

resistanceOutcomes._escalates: What a rung applies *instead* when the target already carries the named condition, chained: a second failure at this rung on an Incapacitated target reads incapacitated -> dying, a third dying -> dead. The book's rule, as data rather than prose.

degrees.note: Stunned instead of Dazed if already Dazed
further failed checks escalate to Dying, then Dead

effects.name: Deflect
effects.description: Bats away or redirects an incoming ranged attack.

effects.name: Elongation

reach.note: Each rank extends the character's reach by the distance value at rank 1 (the extension actions are performed at with no check penalty; the same distance twice over carries -2 and three times over -5).

effects.description: Stretches your limbs or body to extend your reach.

effects.name: Enhanced Movement

config.label: Movement modes
config.hint: Check modes to spend the effect's ranks; tiered modes let you buy increasing scope.

allocOptions.label: Dimensional Travel
allocOptions.description: Travel to another dimension: one fixed dimension, then any of a group, then any dimension at all.

allocOptions.label: Environmental Adaptation
allocOptions.description: Ignore the penalties one environment imposes on movement and checks (zero-g, underwater, extreme cold).

allocOptions.label: Permeate
allocOptions.description: Move through solid matter — slowly at first, then quicker, and at the top tier as fast as you walk.

allocOptions.label: Safe Fall
allocOptions.description: Fall any distance without harm, so long as you are free to move.

allocOptions.label: Slithering
allocOptions.description: Move at your normal ground speed without limbs, and through gaps a body your size would not normally pass.

allocOptions.label: Space Travel
allocOptions.description: Cross interplanetary, then interstellar, then intergalactic distances.

allocOptions.label: Stable
allocOptions.description: Keep your footing on unstable ground: no penalty for moving over a surface that would normally unbalance you.

allocOptions.label: Swinging
allocOptions.description: Swing from anchor points at speed rank 2, given something overhead to catch.

allocOptions.label: Trackless
allocOptions.description: Leave no trail one chosen sense can follow.

allocOptions.label: Wall-Crawling
allocOptions.description: Move across walls and ceilings — one rank slower than your ground speed and vulnerable while you climb, or at full ground speed and not vulnerable.

allocOptions.label: Water-Walking
allocOptions.description: Walk on liquid surfaces at your normal ground speed. The lower tier sinks if you are knocked prone; the higher one does not.

effects.description: Grants specialized movement abilities like wall-crawling or safe falling.

effects.name: Enhanced Senses

config.label: Sense qualities
config.hint: Spend the effect's ranks across sense qualities (each applied to a chosen sense or sense type). Tiered qualities buy increasing scope.

allocOptions.label: Accurate
allocOptions.description: The sense pinpoints a target precisely enough to target with it, rather than only noticing that something is there.

allocOptions.label: Acute
allocOptions.description: The sense distinguishes fine detail, telling one thing apart from another of its kind (one scent from another).

allocOptions.label: Analytical
allocOptions.description: An acute sense that also reads exact composition — the precise chemical make-up, not just 'smells of almonds'.

allocOptions.label: Awareness
allocOptions.description: Notice effects of one chosen descriptor being used at a distance, which is the usual way a Subtle effect gets spotted at all.

allocOptions.label: Counters Concealment
tierLabels: every Concealment on the sense type
allocOptions.description: Ignore Concealment against this sense — one Concealment effect, then every Concealment effect for the whole sense type.

allocOptions.label: Counters Illusion
allocOptions.description: See through an Illusion affecting this sense.

allocOptions.label: Danger Sense
allocOptions.description: Never be caught fully unaware — you get a notice check against surprise through this sense.

allocOptions.label: Dark-Vision
allocOptions.description: See normally in total darkness; darkness does not conceal from this sense at all.

allocOptions.label: Detect
allocOptions.description: A new sense for one thing, quality or effect. It says only that the thing is there — add Accurate, Acute, Radius or Ranged for more.

allocOptions.label: Dimensional
allocOptions.description: Extend every one of your senses into another dimension near where you stand in it — one named dimension, then a related group of them, then any dimension the setting has. The same 1 / 2 / 3 points as the Dimensional extra; take it here or there, not both.

allocOptions.label: Direction Sense
allocOptions.description: Always know which way is north and which way you are facing.

allocOptions.label: Distance Sense
allocOptions.description: Judge distances exactly by sense alone.

allocOptions.label: Extended
allocOptions.description: The sense reaches ten times as far before distance penalties start — one sense, then the whole sense type.

allocOptions.label: Infravision
allocOptions.description: See heat, letting you make out warm shapes in darkness or through smoke.

allocOptions.label: Low-Light Vision
allocOptions.description: Dim light does not conceal — you see in shadow as though it were bright.

allocOptions.label: Microscopic Vision
allocOptions.description: See detail far too small for the naked eye, each tier one step finer (cell, then microbe, then molecule, then atom).

allocOptions.label: Penetrates Concealment
allocOptions.description: Obstacles do not conceal from this sense: it reads straight through them. The lower tier buys a non-accurate sense type, the higher one an accurate sense.

allocOptions.label: Radio
allocOptions.description: A new radio sense: receive broadcast radio signals directly.

allocOptions.label: Radius
allocOptions.description: The sense works in every direction at once, so nothing can approach from a blind side — one sense, then the whole sense type.

allocOptions.label: Ranged
allocOptions.description: A normally touch-range sense works at a distance, at a penalty per space — one sense, then the whole sense type.

allocOptions.label: Rapid
allocOptions.description: The sense takes in detail three time ranks faster than normal, letting you speed-read or catch what flickers past — one sense, then the whole sense type.

allocOptions.label: Time Sense
allocOptions.description: Always know what time it is, and time an event as exactly as a stopwatch.

allocOptions.label: Tracking
allocOptions.description: Follow a trail with the sense, at half speed then at full speed.

allocOptions.label: Ultra-Hearing
allocOptions.description: Hear frequencies above and below the normal range, including ultrasound.

allocOptions.label: Ultravision
allocOptions.description: See ultraviolet light, making otherwise invisible marks and traces visible.

effects.description: Improves existing senses or grants entirely new ones.

effects.name: Enhanced Trait

config.label: Enhances
config.hint: One row per trait you raise, and the ranks put into it. Ranks are allocated out of this effect's rank, and each trait is charged at what it costs to buy normally - so two ranks of a skill cost the same one point whether they go into one skill or two.

effects.description: A bonus to chosen abilities, skills, defenses, resistances, or advantages, held as a power rather than as bought-in traits.

effects.name: Environment

config.label: Imposes
config.hint: Each condition costs its own points per rank and they add together — the lesser version of each is 1, the greater 2. Take the Variable extra to redistribute that total at will instead.

effects.description: Alters conditions in an area — temperature, light, footing, and similar hazards.

effects.name: Extra Limbs

config.label: Applies to
config.hint: The extra limbs add +1 per rank, to a maximum of +5, to either your Grab checks or your Stability. The Variable extra reassigns them each turn instead of fixing the choice here.

effects.description: Grants additional functional limbs for extra actions or grips.

effects.name: Feature

config.label: Features
config.hint: Each rank buys one minor custom capability (e.g. Battery, Built-in Equipment, Quick Change, Remote). Number of features may not exceed the effect's rank.

effects.description: A minor, custom-defined convenience or utility not covered by another effect.

effects.name: Flight
effects.description: Grants the ability to fly at a speed set by rank.

effects.name: Fortune Control
effects.description: Bends luck and probability in or against someone's favor.

effects.name: Growth
effects.description: Increases your size, with knock-on changes to Strength, Toughness, and more.

effects.name: Healing
effects.description: Removes damage conditions from a target on touch.

effects.name: Illusion

config.label: Fools
config.hint: One point per rank per sense type, up to 5 for all of them. Sight counts as two sense types, so any sight illusion costs at least 2 per rank.

config.label: Moves / interacts
config.hint: A moving or interactive illusion needs a Concentrate action to maintain; a static one only needs Sustain.

effects.description: Creates false sensory impressions that fool one or more senses.

effects.name: Immunity

config.label: Immune to
config.hint: Suggested ranks — 1: a single hazard; 2: critical hits / all suffocation; 5: an uncommon descriptor; 10: a common descriptor (cold, fire); 20: a very common damage type; 30: everything one resistance covers. Named scopes' ranks sum to the effect rank.

effects.description: Removes the need to resist a specific effect or descriptor entirely.

effects.name: Insubstantial
effects.description: Turns your body into a less solid, harder-to-affect state, up to fully incorporeal.

effects.name: Leaping
effects.description: Extends how far and high you can jump.

effects.name: Lifting
effects.description: Boosts Strength specifically for lifting and carrying heavy loads.

effects.name: Mind Reading
effects.description: Reads or influences a target's surface thoughts and memories.

effects.name: Morph
effects.description: Changes your appearance to resemble other people or forms.

effects.name: Move Object
effects.description: Telekinetically lifts and moves objects or people at a distance.

effects.name: Nullify

config.label: Nullifies
config.hint: A descriptor, effect type, or named power (GM-approved; broad scopes need review).

effects.description: Suppresses or shuts down another power or effect.

effects.name: Obscure

config.label: Blocks one sense in
config.hint: One point per rank for a single sense (normal sight, normal hearing). Sight costs double.

config.label: Blocks the whole sense type
config.hint: Two points per rank for every sense of that type at once — four for all sight senses. Ten per rank blocks everything.

effects.description: Blankets an area in fog, darkness, or static that blocks a chosen sense.

effects.name: Postcognition
effects.description: Perceives events from the past at your current location.

effects.name: Precognition
effects.description: Grants glimpses or warnings of events yet to happen.

effects.name: Protection
effects.description: A standing bonus to Toughness from tough skin, natural armor, or similar.

effects.name: Quickness
effects.description: Lets you perform non-combat tasks in a fraction of the normal time.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.description: Speeds up how quickly you recover from injury.

effects.name: Remote Sensing

config.label: Displaces
config.hint: Five points per rank for the first sense type and one for each after, up to 10 per rank for all of them. Sight counts as two sense types, so sight Remote Sensing is 6.

effects.description: Projects your senses to a remote location instead of your body.

effects.name: Shrinking
effects.description: Decreases your size, with knock-on changes to Stealth, Defense, and more.

effects.name: Speed
effects.description: Increases your ground movement speed.

effects.name: Summon

subBuild.label: Minion
subBuild.hint: Build the summoned character on effect rank x 15 power points, under your own Power Level. They cannot have minions of their own.

effects.description: Calls forth an ally or creature to fight and act on your behalf.

effects.name: Swimming
effects.description: Increases your swimming speed.

effects.name: Teleport
effects.description: Instantly relocates you (and possibly others) across distance.

effects.name: Transmute

config.label: Can change
config.hint: How broad the source and the result are decides the cost per rank.

options.label: One thing into one other thing
A broad group into one result, or one thing into any of a broad group
A broad group into any of a broad group

effects.description: Changes the material or substance of an object you touch.

effects.name: Variable
effects.description: A flexible pool of points you can reconfigure into different effects on the fly.
